system.description:
Basilisk Art: Adaptive Camouflage · cast at D-Rank to S-Rank · no type

+4 to checks made with the Hide and Sneak actions.

You can't be tracked without the aid of a jutsu.

Serpent Coil: when you deal [Weapon Damage] to a creature you're Hidden from, roll the damage twice and keep the higher.
